text: THE 860 MISSING TENDERS AND VACANCIES DID NOT EXIST. The ingest's sync check reported 200 tenders and 660 vacancies missing, and exited non-zero on a clean run. dosje.gov.in answers a sitemap page number it does not have with page 1 and HTTP 200 instead of a 404 — the five vacancy sitemap files are byte-identical copies of the same 165 URLs — so concatenating them claimed 825 against the 165 the REST API publishes. fetchSitemapUrls de-duplicates now, and deliberately does NOT stop at the first repeated page: tender page 2 repeats page 1 while page 3 holds 112 real records, and an early exit lost them. Every collection now reports fully synced, with the registers intact at 312 tenders, 165 vacancies and 139 schemes. Separately, a register row's sample document is chosen with the register's own noun in front of its category and title: a vacancy titled "Car Driver" in the category "Job" matched no rule and opened the annual-report sample, where it now opens the circular — what the Department itself calls these.
